name: chio-codex
description: Bond every OpenAI Codex plan-then-act loop through the Chio kernel. Seven guards, attested plans, publishable citizens.
author: Backbay Industries

interface.longDescription: The Chio Codex plugin wires the Codex CLI into the chio kernel. Every tool call is routed through chio's seven-guard pipeline and lands as a signed receipt; every session's initial prompt is SHA-256-fingerprinted and embedded in the first receipt as a plan attestation; every successful run can be promoted, via --chio-publish, to a named, scheduled, revocable citizen with a did:chio Agent Passport.
